title: Locally Lipschitz construction of rapidly decreasing character models from generator brackets for concrete regularity structures satisfying assumptions A through C
author: Ismael Bailleul; Masato Hoshino
work: Paracontrolled calculus and regularity structures II
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.172
difficulty_reason: The standard reconstruction and paraproduct estimates do not construct all positive-sector character coordinates from arbitrary generator brackets. The author introduces an intermediate negative-homogeneity regularity structure and then proves the derivative and two-point character bounds by a two-scale dyadic Taylor-remainder induction. Those uniform rapidly decreasing estimates close the algebraic extension and local Lipschitz construction rather than assuming an existing model.
